translations.definition: a. 中國的、中文的  n. 中文、中國人

examples.en: The Chinese delegation signed a multilateral trade agreement after three days of negotiation.

translations.zh-TW: 經過三天談判後，中國代表團簽署了一項多邊貿易協定。

examples.en: Our Beijing office has hired five new engineers who are all Chinese nationals.

translations.zh-TW: 我們的北京辦公室新聘了五位工程師，他們都是中國籍。

examples.en: Learning to read Chinese characters is a requirement for the regional marketing role.

translations.zh-TW: 閱讀中文字的能力是該區域行銷職位的必要條件。

translations.definition: a. 假定的、應該的、被認為的

examples.en: The supplier was supposed to deliver the components by Friday, but the shipment has not arrived.

translations.zh-TW: 供應商應該在週五前交付零件，但貨物至今尚未抵達。

examples.en: The supposed expert turned out to have no formal credentials in chemical engineering.

translations.zh-TW: 這位所謂的專家，後來被發現根本沒有化學工程的正式資格。

examples.en: This software is supposed to streamline payroll processing, yet our team still logs overtime manually.

translations.zh-TW: 這套軟體理應能簡化薪資作業流程，但我們團隊仍要手動加班申報。

translations.definition: n. 蘇維埃（代表會議）、蘇聯人  a. 蘇維埃的、蘇聯的

examples.en: Archivists are still cataloguing Soviet-era documents released after 1991.

translations.zh-TW: 檔案管理員仍在整理 1991 年後解密的蘇聯時期文件。

examples.en: Historians compared the industrial output of the soviets with that of capitalist economies.

translations.zh-TW: 歷史學家將蘇聯的工業產出與資本主義經濟體進行了比較。

examples.en: The museum exhibit displays a Soviet uniform alongside everyday household items from that period.

translations.zh-TW: 博物館展覽將一件蘇聯軍服與當時的日常家用物品並列展出。

translations.definition: n. 銷售、銷售額、營業額

examples.en: Quarterly sales rose by twelve percent, beating the analysts' forecast by a wide margin.

translations.zh-TW: 本季銷售額成長了百分之十二，大幅超越分析師的預測。

examples.en: The sales team will present the new commission structure at Monday's all-hands meeting.

translations.zh-TW: 業務團隊將在週一的全員大會上說明新的佣金結構。

examples.en: Black Friday promotions lifted our sales figures to a record high for the fiscal year.

translations.zh-TW: 黑色星期五的促銷活動將我們的銷售數字推升至本會計年度的歷史新高。

translations.definition: n. 歐洲人  a. 歐洲的、歐洲人的

examples.en: Several European banks lowered their interest rates after the central bank's policy update.

translations.zh-TW: 在央行政策更新後，幾家歐洲銀行調降了利率。

examples.en: Tourists from outside the EU often assume that all Europeans share a single currency.

translations.zh-TW: 非歐盟的遊客常以為所有歐洲人都使用同一種貨幣。

examples.en: The European Commission published new guidelines on cross-border data transfers.

translations.zh-TW: 歐洲執委會發布了關於跨境資料傳輸的新準則。

translations.definition: n. 基督徒  a. 基督教的、基督的

examples.en: The charity is run by a Christian organization that serves families of all faiths.

translations.zh-TW: 這個慈善機構由一個基督教組織經營，服務各種信仰的家庭。

examples.en: Early Christians faced severe persecution before the religion was legalized in the Roman Empire.

translations.zh-TW: 早期基督徒在該宗教於羅馬帝國合法化之前，曾遭受嚴重的迫害。

examples.en: A Christian values framework guided the board's decision on community investment.

translations.zh-TW: 一套基督教價值觀的框架，引導董事會做出關於社區投資的決策。

translations.definition: n. 條件、條款、術語、關係、費用

examples.en: The contract terms specify a thirty-day payment window after invoice receipt.

translations.zh-TW: 合約條款規定，發票開立後三十天內須完成付款。

examples.en: Both parties negotiated the terms of the merger for nearly six months before signing.

translations.zh-TW: 雙方協商合併條件將近六個月，才完成簽約。

examples.en: Technical terms in the user manual must be translated consistently across all language editions.

translations.zh-TW: 使用手冊中的技術術語，在所有語言版本中必須保持一致的翻譯。

translations.definition: n. 法語、法國人  a. 法國的、法國人的、法語的

examples.en: The French subsidiary reported its first profit after three years of restructuring.

translations.zh-TW: 經過三年的重組後，這家法國子公司首度出現獲利。

examples.en: All correspondents at the Geneva office are required to be fluent in both English and French.

translations.zh-TW: 日內瓦辦公室的所有通訊員，都必須精通英語和法語。

examples.en: French wines account for nearly a quarter of the imports in our premium beverage catalog.

translations.zh-TW: 法國葡萄酒在我們的高級飲品目錄中，佔了將近四分之一的進口量。

examples.en: Retailers expect their highest revenue during the Christmas shopping season.

translations.zh-TW: 零售商預期在聖誕節購物季期間，能創下最高的營收。

examples.en: We have spent the last three Christmases at the company's mountain lodge retreat.

translations.zh-TW: 我們過去三個聖誕節，都是在公司的山區小屋度過的。

examples.en: The factory closes for a full week over Christmas to allow staff to visit their families.

translations.zh-TW: 這間工廠在聖誕節期間會關閉整整一週，讓員工返鄉探親。

translations.definition: a. 增長中的、成長中的、日益增加的

examples.en: There is a growing demand for bilingual customer service agents in the Asia-Pacific region.

translations.zh-TW: 亞太地區對雙語客服人員的需求，正日益增加。

examples.en: Our growing workforce now occupies two additional floors in the downtown headquarters.

translations.zh-TW: 我們不斷擴張的員工規模，現已佔用市中心總部的兩個額外樓層。

examples.en: Investors are attracted by the growing market for renewable energy in emerging economies.

translations.zh-TW: 新興經濟體中不斷成長的再生能源市場，吸引了投資人的目光。
